# MeditaDream

> MeditaDream is a free guided meditation app for iPhone and Android: 146 guided meditations, including 17 immersive meditation worlds, in English, French and Spanish, with two voices per language. No subscription, no ads, no in-app purchases and no account. Meditations download once and then play offline. Available free on the App Store (https://apps.apple.com/app/id6808918209) and Google Play (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.edouardrichemond.mindexploreroffline).

## Key facts

- Price: 100% free. No subscription, no ads, no in-app purchases, no premium tier.
- Content: 129 guided meditations in 19 categories (sleep and calm, beginners, 4-minute pauses, self-love and gratitude, shadow work, sacred places, spirit guides, shamanic and trance journeys, Buddhist meditations, qigong, visualization, third eye, non-dual awareness, astral projection), plus 17 immersive worlds; sessions last 3 to 41 minutes.
- Languages: English, French and Spanish, two voices per language; every meditation plays in the chosen language.
- Offline: each meditation or world downloads once, then plays without a connection.
- Also in the app: real ambient sounds (rain, ocean waves, forest, stream, singing bowl, flutes, theta binaural beats) with a sound-only timer, five personal journals (dreams, gratitude and growth, emotions, signs and synchronicities, spiritual experiences), sanctuaries, a companion dragon that grows with practice, a zen passport of stamps, an Oracle that suggests three meditations for how you feel.
- Privacy: no account; journals and progress stay on the phone.
- It is a well-being and learning tool, not medical advice.
- Contact: edouard@meditadream.com

## English

- [Immersive meditation worlds: guided journeys for the mind](https://meditadream.com/en/worlds/): 17 immersive meditation worlds: a mountain temple, Atlantis, a wolf spirit forest. Guided visualization journeys of 13 to 20 minutes, free and offline.
- [Sleep sounds with no ads: rain sounds, ocean waves, flutes and soft drones](https://meditadream.com/en/sleep-sounds.html): Sleep sounds with no ads: rain, ocean waves, forest streams, flutes and soft drones on a 5 to 60 minute timer. A gentler alternative to white noise, offline.
- [A free gratitude journal app: notice the good, one line at a time](https://meditadream.com/en/gratitude-journal.html): A free gratitude journal app with eleven sections, plus guided gratitude meditations. No subscription, no ads, no account, works offline.
- [The MeditaDream Oracle: three meditations for how you feel](https://meditadream.com/en/meditation-oracle.html): Type how you feel and the Oracle turns over three cards: three guided meditations for this moment, plus daily tips. Free, no ads, works offline.
- [Dragon meditation: a companion that grows as you practice](https://meditadream.com/en/meditation-dragon-companion.html): Need meditation motivation? With dragon meditation, a companion hatches from an egg and grows with every minute you meditate. Eleven stages, free, no ads.

- [My Meditations: write your own guided meditation script, free](https://meditadream.com/en/write-your-own-meditation.html): Write a guided meditation script, free, and hear it read aloud on your phone, with your own pauses, even offline. No subscription, no ads.
- [Meditation timer: sit in silence, with a soft interval bell](https://meditadream.com/en/meditation-timer.html): A free meditation timer app for silent meditation: 5 to 120 minutes, an interval bell every 1 to 10 minutes and a soft closing bell. No ads, offline.

- [What is qigong? Benefits, exercises and how to start](https://meditadream.com/en/qigong.html): What is qigong (chi gong)? Origins, benefits, qigong vs tai chi, Ba Duan Jin and simple qigong exercises for beginners, with free guided sessions.
- [Lucid dreaming: what it is and how to have a lucid dream](https://meditadream.com/en/lucid-dreaming-meditation.html): What is lucid dreaming? How to lucid dream with MILD and WBTB, keep a dream journal, explore dream interpretation and try a free lucid dream meditation.

- [Spirit guides and your higher self: who they are and how to connect](https://meditadream.com/en/spirit-guides.html): What are spirit guides? Guardian angels, spirit animals, ancestors, bodhisattvas, the higher self, signs people describe and free spirit guide meditations.
